verdict.rationale: Osborne Clarke is an international law firm offering legal advisory services such as venture financing, IP, data protection and immigration, not a software product. User-configurable background automations are a category error for this kind of offering. The only tooling in the pack, an investor-readiness online check and downloadable cap tables, involves no autonomous or scheduled automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
